content.short: Dognuts is a Cardano NFT collection of collectible dog characters with accessories, traits, and rarity.
content.description: Dognuts is a Cardano NFT collection built around dog-themed collectibles with accessories, traits, and character stories. The project includes different dog characters, each with its own personality, hobbies, and visual identity. Holders can trade Dognuts across Cardano marketplaces and follow collection mechanics tied to hidden objects or special rewards. Its focus is collectible art, community identity, and a playful Cardano NFT universe built around the Dognuts Gang and its holders on Cardano.
